worker.title: ListenerSettings
worker.description: Worker upload API. Default 127.0.0.1:7422. Host `tailscale` binds the machine's Tailscale IPv4 address (remote workers).

host.title: ListenHost
host.description: IP address or hostname to bind.

port.title: ListenPort
port.description: TCP port; 0 picks a free port.

trusted_origins.description: Origins for the human API. The first one is used for login links. Default http://localhost:<human port>.

items.title: TrustedOrigin
items.description: An origin the human API accepts.

origin.description: Browser origin allowed to use the human API, for example `http://localhost:7420`.

mlflow.title: MlflowSidecarSettings
mlflow.description: Managed MLflow sidecar and tracking outbox settings.

enabled.description: Start the managed MLflow sidecar with the coordinator. Default true. When false, tracking writes queue in the outbox.

port.title: ListenPort
port.description: Loopback port for the sidecar. Default 7423. MLflow never binds off loopback.

outbox_max_ops.description: Outbox bound: pending and failed writes. Default 100000.

outbox_max_bytes.description: Outbox bound: queued payload bytes. Default 256 MiB.

jobs.title: JobSettings
jobs.description: Local job runner and collector settings.

supervisor.description: `auto` (default): systemd user scopes when available, otherwise direct mode (limits advisory).

spool_max_bytes.description: Per-attempt collector spool bound. Default 1 GiB.

max_artifact_bytes.description: Largest single artifact upload. Default 2 GiB.

deliver_deadline_sec.description: How long a collector keeps retrying delivery after its job exits. Default 7 days (the worker token grace).

safe_mode.description: Start with every extension inactive: nothing mounts or runs; the Extensions page stays usable for disable and rollback.

require_approval.description: Require the researcher's approval before a build is enabled (ADR 0045). Default false: a successful build in a project is enabled as it is built.

worker_url.description: URL remote workers use to reach the worker listener, for example `http://ws.tail1234.ts.net:7422` over Tailscale. Required before a remote submission; targets may override it.

disconnected_after_sec.description: No heartbeat for this long marks a worker disconnected. Default 3 heartbeats.

export_slack_min.description: Slack added to an exported (Colab) attempt's time limit for its `expected_back_by`: time for a person to open and set up the runtime. Default 30.

upload_token_ttl_sec.description: Lifetime of a remote worker's upload token; refreshed through the handshake. Default 1 day.

launch_token_days.description: Lifetime of a remote worker's launch token, from submission. A disconnection longer than this needs `remote import`. Default 30.

provider_poll_sec.description: How often provider status is checked. Default 60.

artifact_store.title: ArtifactStoreSettings
artifact_store.description: Optional S3-compatible store for remote workers' large artifacts (spec §16 storage table; ADR 0023 decision 24). Workers get presigned PUT URLs only; the keys stay on the coordinator. MLflow remains the artifact store of record.

endpoint.description: S3-compatible endpoint reachable from the workers, for example `https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com` or a MinIO URL.

access_key_id_env.description: Coordinator environment variable holding the access key ID (never stored).

min_bytes.description: Artifacts at least this large go through the store. Default 64 MiB.

slots.description: Presigned upload slots per attempt (one large artifact each). Default 8; more large artifacts use the coordinator's resumable uploads.
